# Files.com

Files.com is a secure cloud storage and file transfer platform that enables businesses to store, share, and manage files across various cloud services and on-premises systems.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/files-com/.

## Actions

- **Delete API Key**: Delete an API key.
- **Delete Permission**: Delete a specified permission.
- **Delete Share**: Delete a specified share link.
- **List Folders** (read-only): List folders.
- **List Groups** (read-only): List groups.
- **List Permissions** (read-only): Retrieve permissions for a specified resource.
- **Get S3 Key for Upload**: Generate a temporary key for file uploads by uploading the file to Files.com.
